name: CleanPowerSF
description: Monthly bill discounts and overdue-bill help for qualifying customers
fullDescription: CleanPowerSF is San Francisco's community choice energy program, run by the SF Public Utilities Commission, providing renewable electricity to residents and businesses, with bill discounts and payment help for qualifying customers.
whatTheyOffer:
- Green service (at least 70% California-certified renewable) with automatic enrollment
- SuperGreen option for 100% California-certified renewable energy
- CARE/FERA monthly discounts (up to 35% off) apply to both the PG&E and CleanPowerSF parts of your bill
- SuperGreen Saver: 100% renewable energy plus a 20% discount for CARE/FERA customers in disadvantaged communities (currently full; waitlist open)
- Help with overdue bills: Arrearage Management Plan (forgives up to $8,000) and REACH (up to $800; funds subject to availability)
- Medical Baseline, LIHEAP, budget billing, and payment plans
howToGetIt:
1. CleanPowerSF enrollment is automatic for SF residents
2. For a monthly discount, enroll in CARE or FERA at pge.com/carefera or call PG&E at 866-743-2273
3. If you have CARE/FERA and live in a qualifying area, apply for SuperGreen Saver to join the waitlist
4. For overdue bills, ask PG&E about AMP (800-743-5000) or Dollar Energy Fund about REACH (800-933-9677)
5. For LIHEAP, call Peninsula Energy Services at 415-416-6660
keywords: CleanPowerSF, renewable energy, green electricity, San Francisco, CARE, FERA, bill relief, solar, wind, clean energy
